summary: The note describes The Groomsmen, a 2006 comedy film written and directed by Edward Burns. It notes the film's limited opening in New York City and Los Angeles on July 14, 2006, and that much of the filming took place at locations on City Island, New York.
one_line: The Groomsmen is a 2006 comedy film written and directed by Edward Burns, opened July 14, 2006, and filmed on City Island, New York.
key_facts: The Groomsmen is a 2006 comedy film.
The Groomsmen was written and directed by Edward Burns.
The Groomsmen opened in New York City and Los Angeles on July 14, 2006.
Filming for The Groomsmen took place at many locations on City Island, New York.
